name: NFT Trader 2022 swap contract counterparty reentrancy
summary: The 2022 NFT Trader swap contract settles the creator's ERC-721 leg before the counterparty leg and has no reentrancy guard, so the attacker re-entered from onERC721Received to repoint the open swap at an address that still held an approval and had that address's Bored Ape or Mutant Ape pulled on settlement. Same defect shape as the 2021 BatchSwap contract, but distinct deployed code with its own age.
notes: Non-upgradeable contract. The runtime code hash is 0xd91249c514889751ab1239777b7309b888b07817671551ed41db8cdbd3becf7a both at the deployment block 14543914 and at block 18797419, and the EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero, so no code change occurred between deployment and the exploit.

26 Bored Apes and 9 Mutant Apes, 35 distinct tokens, were pulled from approval-holding victims through this contract between blocks 18798295 and 18798739. Unit values are the median single-item marketplace fill for each collection over blocks 18790000-18804000, taken only from transactions carrying a Seaport OrderFulfilled or Blur execution event and measured as the payment received by the seller, with every campaign address excluded: BAYC 26.300 ETH from 34 sales, MAYC 5.190 ETH from 85 sales. Those medians are converted at the DefiLlama ETH price for the incident timestamp. The 143 tokens taken through the separate 2021 contract 0xc310e760778ecbca4c65b6c559874757a4c4ece0 are recorded under eip155:1:0x431341c6d41301b7db3b719ccaec8081adf71b707069ea27d71dcdd374d8e6fa and are not counted here. Recovery is excluded: Yuga Labs and Boring Security later paid a 120 ETH bounty and the exploiter returned 36 BAYC and 18 MAYC across both contracts.
